items.title: Risk Culture and Communication
items.summary: Explores how risk culture, tone and communication influence behaviour and decision-making across the organisation.
objectives: Explain how communication supports risk-aware decisions
Identify signs of weak risk culture

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Explores how risk culture, tone and communication influence behaviour and decision-making across the organisation. This lesson focuses on practical understanding, decision-making and evidence-based GRC practice.
bullets: Explain how communication supports risk-aware decisions
Identify signs of weak risk culture

sections.heading: Key concepts
sections.body: Core concepts for risk culture and communication are explained in plain language, with emphasis on roles, controls, risks and expected outcomes in an enterprise context.

sections.heading: Application
sections.body: Learners should be able to apply the concepts to realistic scenarios, justify decisions, and recognise common gaps or weaknesses.

examples.title: Applying Risk Culture and Communication
examples.context: A team must address risk culture and communication in a business scenario with limited time and resources.
examples.outcome: A risk-informed, documented decision with clear ownership and follow-up actions.

practicalExercise.title: Exercise: Risk Culture and Communication
practicalExercise.brief: Apply the lesson to a fictional organisation facing challenges related to risk culture and communication.
practicalExercise.deliverable: A short action plan with rationale.
